description: Expressive Island — system events, notifications, settings, and UI improvements
features: Added expanded battery information with detailed battery status and charging information
Added system event support for more device states and system actions
Added notification timestamp display
Added an option to show the full notification text
Added an option to display the source app name in notifications
Added notification testing options for plain and double notifications
Added configurable notification behaviour for silent notifications, DND, and notification alerts
Added dynamic color controls for system events and notification appearance
Added per-app fallback color options
Added Shizuku integration with status bar, system alert, and permission controls
Added page transition options with fade and slide animations
Added haptic feedback controls for island interactions
Added Split Island behaviour
Added configurable satellite position
Added notification dismissal controls
Improved the Events screen with grouped system event settings and event appearance controls
Improved the Apps screen with search, filtering, sorting, status badges, and Normal only controls
Improved the Behaviour, Animation, Shizuku, Dynamic Tiles, and Events settings screens with clearer section organization
Added a new Expressive Island app identity and updated project branding
Updated profile links and project information for Expressive Island
bugfixes: Fixed duplicate satellite rendering between music and timer dynamic tiles
Fixed album artwork recovery after the MediaSession listener is rebound
Fixed custom expanded height being incorrectly applied to the expanded music player
Fixed notification display options not being applied correctly
Fixed various Dynamic Island UI and interaction issues
Improved music player controls and expanded player behaviour
Improved system event and notification rendering reliability
